parameters.query: SELECT access_token, expires_at FROM oauth_tokens WHERE provider = 'vk_ads' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(lead_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS ids FROM vk_processed_leads;

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  name: $json.name,
  phone: $json.phone,
  email: $json.email,
  title: $json.title,
  description: $json.description,
  funnels_id: 1,
  advertising_source_id: 3,
  club: 1,
  utm_source: $json.utm_source,
  utm_medium: $json.utm_medium,
  utm_campaign: $json.utm_campaign,
  utm_term: $json.utm_term,
  utm_content: $json.utm_content
}) }}

parameters.query: =INSERT INTO vk_processed_leads(lead_id) VALUES ('{{ $json.vk_lead_id }}') ON CONFLICT (lead_id) DO NOTHING;

meta.note: Дедуп durable в Neon (vk_processed_leads). Отметка ПОСЛЕ Fitbase. Токен из oauth_tokens(vk_ads). Лид-формы API v1 ads.vk.com. Контакты в contact_info. UTM: vk_ads/lead_form + campaign=ad_plan_id, term=ad_group_id, content=banner_id (проверь имена полей id по реальному лиду).
